text: Ethics in AI is becoming a very important topic today. As artificial intelligence systems make more decisions in our lives, we must think about bias and fairness. If AI is trained on unfair data, it can treat some groups of people badly. Privacy is another big concern, because AI often collects and uses personal information. Companies should also be transparent about how their systems work, so people can trust them. Finally, responsible AI development means building technology that respects human rights and helps everyone equally. Governments, companies, and researchers must work together to create clear rules. Only then can we enjoy the benefits of AI without causing harm.
